milestone: STORAGE-LIFECYCLE-P1 -- automated bounded retention and safe retirement

watchtower_preservation.method: Baseline captured before any P1 work; identical digest re-verified after all implementation/tests/dry-run. Trivially expected since this milestone performed ZERO writes to any production database at any point -- confirmed structurally (no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE against operators/operator_entities/wt_confirmed_treasuries/wt_watchtower_launches anywhere in the new src/ops/storage_*.py modules) and behaviorally (byte-identical operator row + entities digest before/after).

key_findings_summary.total_disk_free: 62 GiB measured live this session (better than the human's implied situation; NORMAL pressure state per the proposed thresholds, not WARNING/PRESSURE)
key_findings_summary.largest_growth_driver: transfer_index table in flex_complete_database.db -- 5.2M rows, confirmed actively growing via MAX(block_time)
key_findings_summary.retained_acquisition_shadow_db_critical_: Its documented '1GiB daily cap' (src/acquisition/retained_observations.py lines ~257-285) is an in-process Python counter that resets to 0 on every process restart and never checks existing DB size against the cap -- effectively UNBOUNDED across restarts. Only real backstop is a global 'refuse writes if disk free < 10GiB' guard. This is the #1 priority finding for P2.
key_findings_summary.artifact_store_gc_status: Content-addressed (SHA256, true dedup on put()) at src/evidence/artifacts.py. retention_candidates() exists and identifies old artifacts, but the code explicitly states 'EP1.0 never deletes immutable artifacts' -- GC is IDENTIFY-ONLY, no deletion path exists yet.
key_findings_summary.oip_shadow_frozen_classification_counts: 17 directories classified: 6 STILL_RUNTIME_REQUIRED, 5 IMMUTABLE_AUDIT_REQUIRED, 3 COMPACTABLE, 2 REGENERABLE, 1 RETIREMENT_ELIGIBLE (oip_v2_1f_stage_1000, zero code references found), 0 UNKNOWN.
key_findings_summary.duplicate_file_found: primitive_replay.pre_recovery_20260818.sqlite (334MB), MD5-confirmed byte-identical to the live primitive_replay.sqlite, zero code references -- flagged RETIREMENT_ELIGIBLE, not deleted.
key_findings_summary.abandoned_temp_files: 37 .tmp.* files in intelligence_snapshots/, ~825MB total, flagged TEMPORARY -- not deleted.

verdict_reasoning: All P1-authorized safe components are implemented, tested (23/23 passing against isolated fixtures), and verified against real, measured repository data (not fabricated numbers) via a combination of direct investigation and a background census agent. WATCHTOWER_CANONICAL_HISTORY_PRESERVATION passes trivially and structurally (zero writes performed anywhere in this milestone). No destructive production cleanup was performed or activated, consistent with P1's explicit non-authorization. The dry-run correctly reports zero eligible bytes at the CURRENT normal disk-pressure state, and the growth forecast shows no near-term urgency (worst-case 40+ days to the first WARNING threshold) -- so there is no emergency justifying skipping ahead to destructive action. A clear, prioritized P2 activation plan is proposed with explicit GO/NO-GO items, the highest priority being fixing retained_acquisition_shadow.db's genuinely broken (not just imperfect) retention cap.
